title: Influence bound for monotone CNFs
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be monotone. If $f$ is represented by a conjunctive normal form whose clauses each contain at most $w$ distinct literals, where $w\in\mathbb N$, then under the product distribution on signs with $\Pr[X_i=-1]=p$ independently for each coordinate, for any $0<p<1$, the total product influence of $f$ is at most $4w$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$f$ has a CNF representation of width at most $w$
